basic_profile.bio: Avid Animal Crossing fan based in Italy, who enjoys exploring the intricacies of different games and sharing insights with the community. I work as a freelance game designer, which allows me to have flexible hours, mostly active during the late evenings and weekends. Single and loving it, I often spend my free time traveling, particularly to places with rich culinary traditions. I dislike rudeness and always strive for positive exchanges.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Deeply knowledgeable about game design and development, with a focus on simulation and role-playing games. Acquired expertise through a combination of formal education in digital media and self-taught skills honed through years of playing and analyzing games.
